'''Loversknot''' is a horse owned by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].

==Appearance==
Loversknot is a plump brown mare.

==Activities==
Loversknot carried Nynaeve from [[Ebou Dar]] to the [[Kin]]'s [[farm]].{{ref/book|8|2}} She also carried both Nynaeve and [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte]] from the [[Weave#Unweaving|destroyed gateway]] into Andor.{{ref/book|8|20}} Loversknot later [[Traveling|Traveled]] to [[World's End]] with Nynaeve, [[Lan]] and [[Mandarb]].{{ref/book|11|20}}
